subject: Insurance
title: Defensible Space Laws
description: A 60-second lesson on Defensible Space Laws.

hook.text: California requires homeowners to clear vegetation 100 feet around their homes.

buildup.text: Defensible space reduces wildfire damage dramatically. Fire departments prioritize saving homes with cleared perimeters.

discovery.text: Insurers are now requiring defensible space as a coverage condition, not just offering discounts for it.

twist.text: Enforcement is nearly impossible. Thousands of homeowners ignore the mandate.

climax.text: Insurance can incentivize risk reduction, but only if compliance is verifiable and communities act collectively.

punchline.text: Clear 100 feet, save 15%. One neighbor's weeds ruin the block.

quiz.question: How much clearance does California require around homes for defensible space?
